Class Player

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.server.model.Player
public class Player extends Object
Represents a player in the game, managing their state, ship, cargo, and interactions. Handles state changes, cargo operations, tile reservations, and event dispatching.

    • swapCargo

      public void swapCargo(int blockIndex, Point tileCoords, int containerIndex)
      Swaps a block from the cargo pool into a cargo container on the ship. Handles red block restrictions and potential block replacement.
      Parameters:
      blockIndex - the index of the block in the cargo pool
      tileCoords - coordinates of the cargo tile
      containerIndex - the index within the tile’s container
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the block index is invalid
      RuntimeException - if cargo pool is not initialized
